app.name: Carta
app.tagline: Never lose a benefit to paperwork.

home.title: Your notices
home.emptyTitle: Nothing to keep track of yet
home.emptyBody: Take a photo of a letter about your benefits. Carta reads the date off it and reminds you before it passes.
home.noRemindersBody: Carta cannot remind you about this deadline because notifications are turned off.
home.errorTitle: Carta could not open your notices
home.errorBody: Your notices are still saved on this phone. Try again.

disclaimer.notLegalAdvice: Carta is not legal advice and never contacts any agency.

dev.title: Build check
dev.subtitle: Phase 1 scaffold. This screen is replaced by the Home screen in Phase 3.

bench.title: Model benchmark
bench.subtitle: Week 1 latency gate. Downloads the model, runs four cases, and prints a table for NOTES.md.
bench.wifiWarning: This downloads about {{size}} over the internet. Use Wi-Fi. This is the only time Carta uses the network — reading your letters never does.

capture.title: Photograph the notice
capture.instruction: Lay the letter flat and fit the whole page in the frame.
capture.permissionBody: Carta uses the camera to read your notice. Photos stay on this phone.
capture.upsideDownBody: This looks upside down. Carta can still read the words, but it may put the dates in the wrong place. Turning the page around takes a second and fixes it.
capture.noTextBody: Carta could not find any writing. Try again with more light, and fit the whole page in the frame.
capture.errorAcquire: The camera did not return a photo. Try again.
capture.errorResize: Carta could not open that photo. Try taking it again.
capture.errorOcr: Carta could not read any writing. Try again with more light, and fit the whole page in the frame.
capture.errorOrientation: Carta could not tell which way up the page is. Try again with the whole page in the frame.
capture.errorExtract: Carta read the letter but could not pull the details out. You can still type them in yourself.
capture.errorSave: Carta could not save this notice. Try again.
capture.errorSchedule: Carta saved the notice but could not set reminders.
capture.readingBody: Carta is finding the dates and the case number. This takes a few seconds.

review.title: Check what Carta read
review.intro: Carta filled these in from your photo. Tap anything that looks wrong.
review.checkThisWhy: Carta often gets this one wrong in a way that still looks right.
review.machineRead: Read by Carta from your photo
review.noDeadlineBody: Carta could not find a date you need to act by. Add one and Carta will remind you, or save without it.
review.invalidWhy: Carta read this off the page but it does not look like a real value. Check it against the letter.
review.noRemindersBody: Carta saved this notice, but it cannot remind you because notifications are turned off. Turn them on in Settings to get reminders before your deadline.
review.saveFailedBody: Nothing was lost — your photo and the fields are still here. Try Save again.
review.nothingBody: This screen shows what Carta read from a photo. Take a photo of a notice to see it.
review.saveHint: Saves this notice and sets reminders

notifications.permissionNeeded: Carta needs permission to send reminders
notifications.dueBody: Open Carta to see what to send.
notifications.dueTodayBody: Today is the last day. Open Carta to see what to send.
notifications.urgentTitle: Act now to keep your benefits
notifications.urgentBody_one: {{count}} day left to ask for a hearing and keep {{program}} while you wait.
notifications.urgentBody_other: {{count}} days left to ask for a hearing and keep {{program}} while you wait.
notifications.proofBody: This is the reminder you just set for {{program}}.

detail.title: Your notice
detail.mustDoWithDeadline: Send back what the letter asks for before the date below. If you cannot, call your worker before that date and tell them.
detail.mustDoNoDeadline: This letter does not give you a date to act by. Read it carefully, and call your worker if anything is unclear.
detail.mustDoApproval: Nothing. This letter is good news — you do not need to do anything.
detail.noDeadlineFound: Carta did not find a date on this letter. If you can see one, open the notice and add it.
detail.keepBenefitsTitle: To keep your benefits while you appeal
detail.keepBenefitsBody: If you ask for a hearing before {{date}}, your benefits can stay the same until the hearing is decided. Confirm this with your county — Carta is not legal advice.
detail.appealBy: You have until {{date}} to ask for a hearing.
detail.verifiedOn: Office details checked on {{date}}. Call to confirm before you go.
detail.appealsUnavailable: Carta could not load the appeal details. Instructions are printed on the back of the notice itself.
detail.checkBody: Carta read this letter with a machine. Look at the original if anything above seems wrong.
detail.photoDeleted: The photo was deleted after Carta read the letter. Carta keeps the text, not the picture.
detail.textNotStored: The words were not saved for this notice.
detail.textIsAsRead: This is exactly what Carta read from your photo, including any mistakes.
detail.errorTitle: Carta could not open this notice
detail.errorBody: It may have been deleted. Go back and try another one.
detail.saysFrom: This is a letter from {{office}} about your {{program}}.
detail.says_approval: It says your benefits have been approved.
detail.says_denial: It says your application was turned down.
detail.says_reduction: It says the amount you get is going down.
detail.says_discontinuance: It says your benefits are going to stop.
detail.says_info_request: It says they need paperwork from you before they can go on.
detail.says_recert_due: It says it is time to renew, and they need a form back from you.
detail.noTextToExplain: Carta did not save the words from this notice, so it cannot rewrite them.

explain.machineLabel: Written by Carta on this phone, from the words in your photo. It can be wrong — the original is below.
explain.notDownloaded: Carta can rewrite this letter in plain words, on this phone. Turn it on in Settings — it is a one-time download and needs wifi.
explain.withheldTitle: Carta did not show its explanation
explain.withheldBody: Carta checked its own writing and something did not match your letter, so it is not showing it. Read the original below instead.
explain.failedTitle: Carta could not write an explanation
explain.failedBody: Nothing is wrong with your notice. You can read the original below.

worthChecking.title: Worth checking
worthChecking.intro: People who receive {{program}} are often also eligible for these. This is not a decision about your household.
worthChecking.categorical: Receiving {{program}} counts toward this one by rule.
worthChecking.common: Households on {{program}} often qualify, but this program has its own rules.
worthChecking.verifiedOn: Program details checked on {{date}}. Contact the program to confirm.

checklist.title: What to bring
checklist.emptyTitle: Carta does not know what this letter asks for
checklist.emptyBody: The letter may list papers to send back. Add them here so Carta can help you keep track.
checklist.addTitle: What do you need to bring?
checklist.addBody: Pick what the letter asks for. Carta is not saying these are required — only the letter can say that.
checklist.progressBody: Attach each one, or mark it if it does not apply to you.
checklist.readyBody: Everything on this list is done. Send it before the date on your notice.
checklist.doesNotApply: This does not apply to me
checklist.skipIt: Mark {{name}} as not applying to you
checklist.photographBody: The photo stays on this phone. Carta never sends it anywhere.
checklist.alreadyHave: Or use one you already saved
checklist.noneStored: You have not saved any papers yet.
checklist.attachFailed: Carta could not save that photo. Try again.
checklist.cameraDenied: Carta needs the camera to take a photo. You can turn it on in Settings.
checklist.errorTitle: Carta could not open your list
checklist.errorBody: Something went wrong reading what you need to bring.
checklist.openChecklistHint: Open the list of papers this letter asks for
checklist.summaryNone: Carta does not know what this letter asks for yet.
checklist.summaryReady: Everything on your list is done.

vault.title: Your papers
vault.intro: Papers you attached to a notice are kept here, so you do not photograph the same one twice.
vault.emptyBody: When you attach a paper to a notice, Carta keeps it here for next time.
vault.ruleCheckedOn: This rule was checked on {{date}}. Confirm with your county.
vault.noFreshnessRule: Carta does not know how recent this kind of paper has to be. Ask your county.
vault.storedHere: These stay on this phone. Carta never sends them anywhere.
vault.missingTitle: Carta could not open that photo
vault.missingBody: The file is not on this phone any more. You can photograph it again from the notice it belongs to.
vault.errorTitle: Carta could not open your papers
vault.errorBody: Something went wrong reading what you saved.

where.title: Where to go
where.intro: These work without internet. Call before you travel — hours change.
where.accessibilityTitle: Interpreters and help filling out forms
where.genericList: You have no notice saved yet, so this is the general list.
where.walkInUnknown: Carta does not know if you can walk in. Call first.
where.hoursUnknown: Carta does not have the hours for this office. Call first.
where.notHereBody: Carta does not have verified details for these yet. Call the county line above.
where.errorTitle: Carta could not open the office list
where.errorBody: Something went wrong reading the office details.

onboarding.whatBody: Take a photo of a letter about your benefits. Carta reads the date off it and reminds you before it passes — so a form does not get missed while you are working.
onboarding.privateBody: Carta does not have an account, a server, or a way to send your letter anywhere.
onboarding.privatePoint1: Your letter is read on this phone, not online.
onboarding.privatePoint2: Carta never contacts your county, and never contacts immigration.
onboarding.privatePoint3: It works in airplane mode. You can turn off wifi and try it.
onboarding.modelBody: Carta can also rewrite a letter in plain words. That needs a one-time download.
onboarding.modelPoint2: It runs on this phone, so it works offline afterwards.
onboarding.modelPoint3: Everything else in Carta works without it.
onboarding.modelLater: You can turn this on later in Settings. Nothing is missing without it.
onboarding.downloadHint: Starts the download and takes you to Carta. It keeps going in the background.
onboarding.downloadFailedBody: Nothing is wrong with Carta — everything works without this. You can try again later in Settings.

settings.title: Settings
settings.modelWhat: Carta can rewrite a letter in plain words, on this phone. It is optional — everything else works without it.
settings.modelDownloadHint: Downloads the file that lets Carta rewrite letters in plain words. Uses wifi.
settings.modelReady: Downloaded. Carta can rewrite letters in plain words.
settings.modelDeleteHint: Frees the space. You can download it again later.
settings.modelFailedBody: Nothing is wrong with Carta — everything works without this. Check wifi and try again.
settings.reminderWhat: Carta reminds you before a deadline. Pick the time of day that works.
settings.privacyStored: Everything Carta reads stays on this phone. There is no account and no server.
settings.privacyPhoto: The photo of your letter is deleted once Carta has read it.
settings.privacyNetwork: The only thing Carta ever downloads is the optional file above. Nothing about your letter is ever sent anywhere.
settings.privacyExact: The text of the letter is encrypted with AES-256-GCM under a key that never leaves the device; the case number is never stored, only a salted hash and the last four digits; the deadline dates, the programme, and the recipient's name are stored in plaintext so the app can sort, display and correct them, and the photograph is a plain file inside the app sandbox.
settings.wipeWhat: Removes every notice, every document, every reminder and the key that unlocks them. This cannot be undone.
settings.wipeConfirmBody: Every notice, document and reminder will be gone. This cannot be undone.
settings.wipePartialBody: Carta could not finish: {{steps}}. Try again, and if it keeps failing you can delete the app itself, which removes all of it.
